ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) base with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 15-25% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation (RGB < 50,50,50) with high-contrast white circular and amorphous blobs distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes; highest concentration of white intensity is located at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; calculated internal angle approximately 40-50 degrees; significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 10 to 40 pixels in depth; most pronounced along the medial-to-mid section of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending laterally and upward from the median notch toward the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally upward slope relative to the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-20 pixel diameters) scattered across both lobes, indicating significant localized surface scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white calcified texture and extensive scarring visible on the distal tips of both fluke lobes; irregular trailing edge morphology suggesting cumulative physical trauma.
